ku.text: A change of $r\%$ per period multiplies the value by $1+r/100$ for growth or $1-r/100$ for depreciation.
For $n$ equal periods, $V_n=V_0(1+i)^n$ when $i$ is the rate per period.
Make the interest rate and number of periods consistent.

misc.better: Percentage depreciation is applied to the value at the start of each year.

worked.prompt: A machine worth $8000$ depreciates by 15% each year. Find its value after two years.
